Looking for creative problem-solvers—especially in UI/UX, data analysis, or storytelling/pitching—to join the team!
summary: GeoSignal is an advanced Earth Systems Trend Detective and disaster early warning dashboard developed to address climate trend analysis and environmental monitoring. The platform directly leverages multi-decadal NASA POWER reanalysis assets—including Surface Air Temperature, Precipitation, and Soil Wetness—combining them with non-parametric Mann-Kendall Z-scores, Sen’s slope decadal rates, and p < 0.05 significance testing to reliably distinguish true ecological trajectories from natural interannual variability.To bridge long-term climate analytics with acute emergency response, GeoSignal integrates a real-time USGS seismic telemetry feed equipped with an automated risk classification matrix that maps tectonic events into severe tsunami warnings and moderate advisories. Built using a robust Next.js serverless architecture with shareable deep-link state parameters and professional PDF brief export capabilities, GeoSignal delivers a complete, decision-support tool designed for immediate global impact and resilience.
details:
• What it does & How it works: GeoSignal is an advanced climate trend analysis and real-time disaster early-warning dashboard. It integrates multi-decadal NASA POWER telemetry and live USGS seismic data through an interactive 3D globe, comparative anomaly charts, and an automated hazard classification engine.
  • Benefits & Impact: Empowers local communities, researchers, and emergency responders to proactively monitor tectonic activity and anticipate climate extremes before they escalate.
  • Tech Stack: Built with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, NASA POWER API, and the USGS Live Feed API.
  • Creativity & Design: Combines long-term climate analytics with live disaster tracking into a lightning-fast, highly accessible web application with instant PDF brief generation and data provenance transparency.
